settings.title: Save timeout
settings.why: How long saving the position may take before that attempt is abandoned.

settings.title: Failed saves tolerated
settings.why: How many saves in a row may fail before the job restarts.

settings.title: Pause between saves
settings.why: The least time between two saves, so a slow destination still gets time to write.

settings.title: Restart strategy
settings.why: How the job restarts after a failure.

settings.title: First restart delay
settings.why: Exponential delay: the wait before the first restart.

settings.title: Longest restart delay
settings.why: Exponential delay: the longest wait between restarts.

settings.title: Restart attempts
settings.why: Fixed delay: restarts before the job fails for good.

settings.title: Restart delay
settings.why: Fixed delay: the wait between restarts.

settings.title: Managed memory
settings.why: The share of TaskManager memory Flink keeps off the heap for RocksDB and batch work. A pipeline keeps its state on the heap, so little is needed.

settings.title: Network memory
settings.why: The share of TaskManager memory for buffers between operators.

settings.title: Internal call timeout
settings.why: How long the JobManager and TaskManagers wait for each other's answers.

settings.title: Heartbeat timeout
settings.why: How long without a heartbeat before a TaskManager counts as lost.
